ai_overview_references.title: Which sources ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini cite when ...

answer_text:
In September 2026, research by Matt Turley at Continuum across "who should I hire" and "what should I use" recommendation questions found that Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Gemini collectively cited 39,763 links across 3,118 answers. For Perplexity specifically on broader domain breadth studies (such as Hendricks' The Answer Index in September 2026), Perplexity drew on 4,788 distinct domains (averaging about 15.3 domains per answer). uxcontinuum.com +1
Company websites: 50.2%
Directories and review sites: 25.9%
"Best X" listicles: 11.8%
Reddit / LinkedIn / YouTube / Wikipedia: 2.2% / 1.0% / 0.2% / 0.1% uxcontinuum.com
The Answer Index (Hendricks.AI, September 2026): Tracked US English answer panels and found Perplexity utilized 4,788 distinct domains overall.
Surfer AI Search Analytics (September 1–28, 2026): Tracked ~10.37 million Perplexity citations across 978,402 answers, noting that the top 50 cited domains accounted for only 9.0% of all citations (leaving 91.0% to long-tail, niche, and local domains). Positive Surfer
Would you like to know which specific categories or review directories (such as Yelp or specialized local lists) received the highest share of Perplexity citations in that dataset?
prompt_text: How many different web domains did Perplexity cite when it answered local business recommendation questions in September 2026, according to published research? Give the number and name the source.
